additional_info.subject: 0410867 - ID0410577-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002654] Iplanet  Outlets unavailable( C1) CRM:00314000149
additional_info.body:
Buonasera Luigi,
I am reaching out from the Expert Services Team in regards of ticket
ID0410867.
The ticket was opened for charger
m6Wiqu
as it experienced the outlets being detected as unavailable. An analysis conducted showed that the charger was severely affected by “error polling coap”, which is a communication timeout between the PLC and the SECC.
Today I applied a Hotfix on the charger, and the issue should be now solved. The Hotfix consists into a new version of the SECC firmware, which solves these communication interruptions.
I will proceed to close this child ticket then. If you will experience in the future further issues on other chargers of outlets going OoO due to “error coap polling”, please refer again with a ticket to our NOC Team.
Wish you a nice weekend!
With kind regards,
